title: Cellular Senescence in Animals: Cell-Cycle Arrest and Tissue Context
topic: Programmed Cell Death, Aging and Senescence in Animals and Plants
word_count_method: Unicode letter/digit tokens in the actual saved p.teaching-prose paragraphs; total visible article excludes SVG internals and diagram button labels; narrative excludes all practice, tables, revision and references.

scope.merged: CSIR-UGC-DBT revised 2026 Unit 5.E p6, screenshot checked
scope.separate: CSIR Life Sciences 2026 Unit 5.E p4 screenshot checked
scope.set: MP SET 2024 Unit 5.E p4 screenshot checked on third-party host
scope.boundaries: 2.D full cycle and apoptosis; 4.E cancer-specific senescence escape; 5.E.03 developmental death; 5.E.05 whole animal aging; 5.E.06–10 plant processes.

dimensions.A: Viable durable arrest, fate distinctions and necessity
dimensions.B: Hayflick/Moorhead 1961, Harley et al. 1990, Bodnar et al. 1998, Serrano et al. 1997, Dimri et al. 1995, developmental 2013 and wound 2014 evidence
dimensions.C: Telomeric repeats, G-overhang, shelterin, kinase and lysosomal activity
dimensions.D: Damage sensing, p53/p21, p16/RB, E2F regulation, secretion
dimensions.E: ATP-dependent phosphorylation, redox and lysosomal pH; no forced thermodynamic calculations
dimensions.F: Arrest stabilization and feedback, signaling and clearance
dimensions.G: Population doubling, simplified telomere shortening, cell balance and secretion normalization
dimensions.H: Recovery, controls, genotype/rescue, conditioned media, neutralization and tissue context
dimensions.I: Cell, lineage, embryo, wound and tissue-level consequences
dimensions.J: Human/mouse culture differences, plant boundary and developmental/adult comparison
dimensions.K: p53 and RB loss, telomerase restoration, RAS and candidate factor perturbations
dimensions.L: Marker nonspecificity, heterogeneity, reversible arrest, limits of models and denominator effects
dimensions.M: Cell-culture interpretation, tissue repair research and biological significance; no clinical treatment protocol
dimensions.N: Links to cycle control, apoptosis, cancer and next aging node
dimensions.O: 50 explained original questions with balanced and varied answer positions

review_pass_1: Internal scientific/syllabus pass: all roadmap concepts located; primary records and consensus marker literature checked; corrected developmental p21 independence and lysosomal assay pH; verified causal versus correlational statements and model assumptions. Independently recomputed all numerical problems: 3, 5 doublings; 40 doublings; 11.1%; 300, 600 cells; secretion .001/.002 and .003 pg/cell/h; counts 100/200; 80/170; fold 4/1.8; 100 pg/mL; 7.5 kb; 216 cells. No claimed universal thresholds.
review_pass_2: Separate internal teaching and examination pass: re-fetched saved HTML, confirmed unique 163 teaching paragraphs with 14815 words; compared 4.E.06 comparator (14057 words, 143 paragraphs); inspected practice answer and distractor reasoning, corrected predictable ordering, added reader practice style, telomere diagram and published related links; verified all IDs, fragment links, ARIA references and zoom target IDs. No external peer reviewer or interactive browser/device/screen-reader validation.

quality.assessment: Internal self-assessment; deductions for SET mirror, selected primary abstracts and reviews rather than exhaustive full text, limited conceptual recurrence, simpler foundational distractors and static-only technical validation.

navigation.mechanism: Existing dynamic menu resolution checks only published links; both adjacent chapters unlinked at baseline, controls remain disabled until available. No nonexistent static links or neighbor files changed.
